<p align="center"><strong>The ward is restored. Leave with the names, or keep the threshold.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Moonseed &middot; Copper coil &middot; Star lantern &middot; Sky bearing &middot; Beacon restored &middot; Black cat companion</small></p>


<p align="center">Seed. Coil. Lantern. The beam strikes the northern path. Every pumpkin goes dark; small lights rise from their mouths and gather beyond the gate.</p>

<p align="center">A hand presses against the outside of the window. With no face left to borrow, Mother Hollow slips between the trees. The thirteenth knock never comes.</p>

<p align="center">Elias reaches the stair, his own voice at last. &quot;Ada?&quot; One small light waits for him. Before joining it, he tells you the ward will need a keeper when next Halloween comes.</p>
